import os
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['MKL_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
import opendssdirect as dss

# Build circuit (text-command DSL)
dss.Text.Command('Clear')
dss.Text.Command('New Circuit.src basekv=12.47 phases=3 bus1=src')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l1 bus1=src bus2=m1 length=3 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l2 bus1=m1 bus2=endb length=4 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.lda bus1=m1 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=700 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldb bus1=endb phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=1400 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('Set voltagebases=[12.47]')
dss.Text.Command('CalcVoltageBases')

# Apply modifications
dss.Loads.Name('ldb')
dss.Loads.kW(2600.0)

# Run analysis
dss.Solution.Solve()
assert dss.Solution.Converged(), 'power flow did not converge'

# Extract result
dss.Circuit.SetActiveBus('endb')
_nodes = list(dss.Bus.Nodes())
_v = dss.Bus.puVmagAngle()
result = _v[2 * _nodes.index(1)]
print(round(float(result), 6))

os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['MKL_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
import opendssdirect as dss

# Build circuit (text-command DSL)
dss.Text.Command('Clear')
dss.Text.Command('New Circuit.src basekv=12.47 phases=3 bus1=src MVAsc3=15000 MVAsc1=12000')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l1 bus1=src bus2=b1 length=2 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l2 bus1=b1 bus2=b2 length=3 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l3 bus1=b2 bus2=b3 length=3 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.llat bus1=b1 bus2=lat length=2 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.lda bus1=b2 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=900 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldb bus1=b3 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=1100 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldc bus1=lat phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=700 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('Set voltagebases=[12.47]')
dss.Text.Command('CalcVoltageBases')

# Apply modifications
dss.Lines.Name('l2')
dss.Lines.Length(4.8)

# Run analysis
dss.Text.Command('Set mode=faultstudy')
dss.Solution.Solve()
assert dss.Solution.Converged(), 'fault study did not converge'

# Extract result
dss.Circuit.SetActiveBus('b3')
_r, _x = dss.Bus.Zsc1()
result = (_r ** 2 + _x ** 2) ** 0.5
print(round(float(result), 6))
